extras: Requires an external, administrator-provided HTTPS service and Vault permissions. The plugin is proprietary and does not collect client-side telemetry.
intentEvidence: Read concise AI summaries beside your Obsidian notes.
problem: Manually connecting related knowledge across notes and keeping track of automated AI modifications is time-consuming and complex.
summary: AI assistant that generates concise summaries beside notes, connects related knowledge, and allows review or undo of automated background changes.
